name: 19970 · Ocean View, DE
findings: ZIP 19970 (Ocean View) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19970 (Ocean View) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19970 (Ocean View) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
